messages:
omar: FYI noticing LB backends in rack-23 dropping connections to pods on rack-24, started ~09:12 UTC. High retry rate from upstream tests.
lia: is this the same noisy ToR we've seen earlier?
omar: different symptoms — latency spikes + SYN retransmits, not just full flaps. tcpdump shows repeated ARP requests with no reply from a subset of hosts.
jia: can you paste the capture snippet?
omar: ```15:12:03.123 ARP, Request who-has 10.10.23.45 tell 10.10.23.1, length 46
15:12:03.129 ARP, Request who-has 10.10.23.45 tell 10.10.23.1, length 46
(no reply for ~200ms then intermittent reply)```
lia: that smells like ARP suppression/NDProxy failure on the ToR ASIC. Did we push any ToR config recently?
mike: pushed EVPN route fix for rack-21 earlier but not rack-23. No ToR config change logged for 23 in last 24h.
ops-oncall: I see elevation in LB 5xxs and 50% backend churn in the console, routing layer showing some sessions moved to fallback pool.
jia: any MTU/fragmentation evidence? RDMA workload shows stalls.
omar: checking ethtool and neighbor table: `ip neigh show dev eth0 nud_failed` returns several entries for pod IPs on rack-24. ethtool shows no link flaps. MTU is consistent at 9000.
lia: could be hardware ARP suppression bug when the neighbor table scales and evicts entries — leads to no hardware reply until kernel refills. We've seen ASIC bug on version 3.1.2. What ToR firmware?
\om ar: TO clarify: sw ver on TOR-23 is 3.1.2-rc2.
mike: ah — that's the suspect build. Rack-12 had intermittent drops with same image in Dec. Ops rolled a mitigation there (disable ARP suppression).
ops-oncall: can we toggle ARP suppression on TOR-23 as quick mitigation? Impact: more CPU on ToR, slightly higher broadcast.
jia: yes, disable suppression on the affected ToRs and monitor. Also add a neighbor refresh cron on critical hosts as short-term.
omar: running command now on tor-23a: `switchctl set arp_suppression false`
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0451 - ToR ARP suppression causing LB connection failures. Severity: P2.
omar: switched suppression off on tor-23a/23b. Immediate drop in error rate on LB logs, 10s stabilization window.
\mlike: rolling to tor-24? wait, tor-24 is where victim IPs lived — suppress still on tor-24. We should disable there too.
lia: coordinate with networking team for firmware rollback plan. Need postmortem and tracking ticket for vendor fix.
ops-oncall: adding temporary firewall rules to avoid noisy ARP storms if it happens, and raising monitoring alert for `arp_reqs_without_replies`.
jia: follow-up: create a runbook step to detect ARP suppression regressions (increase in neighbor nud_failed + LB 5xxs correlation).
omar: thanks. I'll keep monitoring. Reopen if we see >1% drop in backend success rate.
